run_kmeans_benchmark: run k-means clustering on MNIST data using FAISS with configurable GPUs and cluster count
load_mnist_function: load MNIST image data from an IDX3-ubyte binary file and return a numpy array
train_kmeans_function: train k-means clustering on float32 data using one or multiple GPUs via FAISS
review_train_kmeans: review the train_kmeans function to understand GPU resource allocation and index configuration
refactor_load_mnist: refactor the load_mnist function to use context managers and support additional IDX formats
